A1.justification: Both 11-page PDFs describe Agentic Retoucher and contain readable text, equations, figures, and tables supporting reliable comparison. Neither contains an appendix or embedded supplement; supplementary material mentioned in both is not included in the supplied PDFs.

before.justification: v1 reports original retouching experiments, a five-participant human evaluation, perception and reasoning evaluations, and component ablations in Tables 1-5 and Figures 4-5.

after.justification: v3 retains the work's original quantitative experiments, human evaluation, ablations, and qualitative results in Tables 1-5 and Figures 4-5.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same perception-reasoning-action loop, ViT-T5 saliency predictor, MSE/KLD objective, LoRA SFT followed by GRPO, and adaptive inpainting procedure. The method text and equations differ only in citation numbering.

E1.justification: Both versions use GenBlemish-27K and SynArtifacts-1K for the same retouching, distortion localization, and reasoning tasks. GenBlemish-27K retains 6,025 images, 27,507 annotated regions, and 12 distortion categories; no evaluated domain or scenario is added.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1-5. Table 1 retains Qwen-Edit, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, Flux-fill, and SD-inpainting; the perception and reasoning comparisons also retain their original methods and variants. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains the same metrics, model configurations, and reported experimental settings. Table 2 still describes a randomized, blind survey with five participants. No revised sampling, preprocessing, training budget, or testing procedure is reported.

E4.justification: Sections 5.3-5.4 retain the same perception and reasoning analyses, attention/KLD ablations, SFT-versus-GRPO comparisons, and action-tool conditioning comparisons. The qualitative cases in Figures 4-5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: The annotation-agreement reporting and human-preference percentages are unchanged. Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-5 and the qualitative result images are unchanged. Both report 47.10 GenBlemish-27K plausibility for Ours w Qwen-Edit and 83.2% favorable human judgments; these are retained results, not improvements between versions.

T1.justification: The iterative update in Equation 1, saliency objective in Equation 2, GRPO objective in Equation 3, and LoRA factorization are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same three-agent framework, GenBlemish-27K contribution, and claims about perceptual quality, distortion localization, and human preference alignment.

C2.justification: The explanations of VLM grounding failures, attention/KLD complementarity, progressive alignment, and generalization remain unchanged. No new substantive limitation, failure condition, or applicability qualification is introduced.

D1.justification: The annotation instructions and implementation disclosures are unchanged, including learning rate 2×10^-5, LoRA rank 64 and alpha 32, and 2-3 inference iterations. No hardware, training-time, code-access, or data-access information is added.

R1.justification: v3 retains all 73 earlier references and adds six: FineVQ, F-bench, LATO, D2-VR, and papers on one-step super-resolution and ID-specific face restoration. These extend citation lists in Sections 1-2 without adding substantive comparative discussion or changing the claimed research gap.

P1.justification: v3 adds equal-contribution and corresponding-author notes, updates affiliations, and introduces a funding acknowledgment before the references. The scientific prose and main section organization otherwise remain unchanged apart from citations and text reflow.

P2.justification: New first-page footnotes and the acknowledgment modestly reflow the opening text and bibliography. Figures 1-5 and Tables 1-5 retain their visual content, structure, and captions; no scientific display is added or redesigned.

improvement.justification: v3 adds authorship and funding disclosures and six background citations, but the citations do not develop the related-work argument. The method, reproducibility information, experimental evidence, interpretations, and conclusions remain unchanged. These limited editorial additions do not establish a meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
